summary: Recover chain runtime after transient upstream guard failures
details: Wait and retry startup RPC failures; gracefully stop geth after repeated monitoring errors and resume only after validating the existing reorg baseline.
Preserve persistent deep-reorg incidents, miner configuration and chain data, and reap stopped writers before starting a replacement process.
Keep retry waits interruptible and let Docker restart the container after unexpected guard exits or geth crashes.
operator_actions: Update the chain image and recreate the chain container to apply the runtime fix; replacing the host node-kit scripts alone is insufficient.
Retain baseline.json and halted.json. Transient RPC recovery requires no new mining enable operation or controller process.
